description: Generate UUIDs (v1/v4), secure random tokens, and API-key-format strings

count.description: How many values to generate (default 1, clamped to 1-100).

type.description: Alias for version: v1 for a timestamp-based UUID; any other value (default v4) gives a random v4 UUID (or the api_key/token value selected by format).

name: generate-uuid
